title: Product Manager for Insurance
full_description:
Amsterdam, Netherlands
€4.596,95 - €7.460,78
Be the insurance commercial expert in the team. Ensure the best possible online experience for our customers, driven by your data and insights. Are you passionate about accelerating business growth and delivering seamless customer experiences? Read on!
The team | TribeYou will join a dynamic, self-steering strategy and distribution team within ING’s Insurance Tribe. Together with colleagues from different areas of expertise, you will work on projects that accelerate growth, innovate to enhance our digital propositions and strengthen our partnerships. Our culture is collaborative, data-driven, and focused on continuous improvement.
Roles and responsibilities
Serveas the commercial and product expert, analyzing customer behavior and market trends to inform product strategies.
Createcompelling business cases, develop projections, and lead projects alongside your team and key stakeholders.
Manageexternal stakeholder relationships and third-party partnerships to maximize business opportunities.
Definetargets, set KPIs, and lead performance review meetings with partners.
Actas the insurance domain expert, sharing industry insights and best practices within the team.
Leadproject management for new proposition development, ensuring successful implementation and launch.
Analyzecustomer segmentation and behavior to create effective distribution strategies.
Optimizecustomer journeys by conducting funnel analysis and removing friction points, leveraging data-driven insights.
Conductrisk analysis and ensure compliance with relevant policies and procedures, aligning with regulatory standards.
Demonstrate a strong analytical mindset, turning data into actionable insights.
Be process-oriented and able to deep-dive into complex topics.
Show excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
Exhibit project management expertise and lead cross-functional initiatives.
Possess solid knowledge of risk management principles and regulatory requirements.
Embrace a collaborative attitude and thrive in self-steering teams.
Willingness to learn, grow, and take ownership of the business.
Bachelor’s degree required (Master’s preferred).
Proven experience in marketing, product management, or digital sales in the insurance industry.
Strong team player with a proactive learning attitude.
Currently residing in the Netherlands.
We want to make sure that it’s possible for you to strike the right balance between your career and your private life. You can find out more about our employment conditionshere.
